title: Halcyon: the real network
brief: Now the whole company: public web, mail, offices and HR, all feeding the same database. All five attack types will show up. Money is limited, so build only what each wave needs.
debrief: Look at each route: where do the attacks pass? Segmentation means they have several nodes where you can stop them.
hint.1: The edge sees everything from the internet: firewall and MFA there stop floods and password guessing.
hint.2: Mail needs a filter, the office a patch, and the database a backup.
hint.3: You can sell a defense for half its price if you need money.
walkthrough: Wave 1 firewall and MFA on the edge, wave 2 filter on mail and patch on the office, wave 3 backup on the database. Wave 4 is already covered.
